description: This file provides functions to fetch a project's name from a backend API endpoint, with a fallback mechanism. It includes two exported functions: fetchProjectNameDirect and fetchProjectNameByProjectId, which retrieve the project name given a project ID.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameDirect
methods.description: Fetches the project name directly using either a custom API client or fallback to axios, given a project ID.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId
methods.description: Deprecated alias for fetchProjectNameDirect, retained for compatibility.
